title: 60-Second Alliance Reset
concept: Emergency co-present reboot when winning has replaced connecting. Stops damage in one minute, then schedules real repair.
whenToUse: Emergency reboot when the conversation has become about winning. Use when co-present and willing to stop for one minute before a longer pause.
steps: Name — “I want to connect, not fight.”
Return — set a specific time to continue.

phrases.text: I want to connect, not fight.
I’m stopping so we don’t do damage.

working: Mid-fight in the kitchen. A: “I’m stopping. I want to connect, not fight.” Hand on shoulder if welcome. Three breaths. “Can we talk at 8pm?” B agrees. They leave the content until 8.
notWorking: Using the reset as control: “60-second reset — I’m done” with no return time. That is withdrawal in protocol clothing. Always pair stop with return.
activity: Practice the five steps on a fake topic (“dishes”) three times while calm. Agree the recognition phrase both will honour.
